o.text: From Arabic جَمْعِيَّة (jamʕiyya). By surface analysis, cəm + -iyyət.
From Persian انسیت (onsiyyat), from Arabic اُنْسْ (uns).
Borrowed from Russian комба́йн (kombájn), from English combine.
From tap- + -maca, an unproductive suffix that is perhaps only present in boğmaca and çəkməcə.
